title: OpenAIs HealthBench in Action: Evaluating an LLM-Based Medical Assistant on Realistic Clinical Queries
authors: Sandhanakrishnan Ravichandran; Shivesh Kumar; Rogerio Corga Da Silva; Miguel Romano; Reinhard Berkels; Michiel van der Heijden; Olivier Fail; Valentine Emmanuel Gnanapragasam
why_relevant: Evaluates a medical RAG assistant on HealthBench, touching on uncertainty handling and context-seeking, but is primarily an application/benchmark report not focused on robustness mechanisms.
why_not_or_caveat: No study of noise, conflict, adversarial robustness, or calibration methods; just leaderboard-style evaluation of a proprietary system.
